reading: いいてんきですね
note: Classic opener with neighbours, shop owners or someone you're waiting with.

reading: きょうはあついですね
note: Small talk in summer; the other person usually just agrees: 本当ですね.

reading: さむいですね
note: Winter opener with anyone, from coworkers to the person at the bus stop.

reading: きょうはむしあついね
note: Among friends in Japan's sticky summer.

reading: あめがふりそうですね
note: Said looking at the sky; a safe, polite remark to anyone.

term: 早く梅雨明けないかなあ。
reading: はやくつゆあけないかなあ
back: I wish the rainy season would end.
note: A very Japanese June–July grumble between friends.

reading: さいきんどう
note: Easy catch-up question to a friend you haven't talked to lately.

reading: しごとはどう
note: To a friend or relative; expect a short answer like まあまあ.

reading: さいきんいそがしいの
note: To a friend you haven't heard from; slightly concerned, friendly.

reading: あいかわらずいそがしいよ
note: Common reply to 最近どう？ or 忙しい？

term: 最近何かいいことあった？
reading: さいきんなにかいいことあった
note: Light question to get a friend talking.

reading: きょうはどうだった
note: Family or partner, in the evening.

reading: しゅうまつはどうだった
note: Monday chat with friends or close coworkers.

reading: こんしゅうまつはなにするの
back: What are you up to this weekend?
note: To a friend or coworker toward the end of the week.

reading: こんしゅうまつあいてる
note: Usually leads into an invitation.

reading: よいしゅうまつを
note: Said on Friday when parting from coworkers or acquaintances.

term: 普段、休みの日は何をしてるの？
reading: ふだんやすみのひはなにをしてるの
back: What do you usually do on your days off?
note: Getting-to-know-you question among peers.

reading: しゅみはなんですか
back: What do you do for fun?
note: Standard polite question on a first meeting; answer 趣味は〜です.

term: 最近何かはまってることある？
reading: さいきんなにかはまってることある
note: Casual way to ask about hobbies, shows, games, food trends.

term: 最近何か面白い映画見た？
reading: さいきんなにかおもしろいえいがみた
note: Easy topic between friends.

term: お仕事は何をされているんですか？
reading: おしごとはなにをされているんですか
back: What do you do for work?
note: Polite, to someone you've just met at a party or event.

term: どこに住んでいるんですか？
reading: どこにすんでいるんですか
note: Usually answered with a neighbourhood or nearest station.

reading: にほんははじめてですか
back: Is this your first time in Japan?
note: What Japanese people often ask visitors.

reading: にほんはどうですか
note: Common friendly question to visitors and newcomers.

term: 日本語がお上手ですね。
reading: にほんごがおじょうずですね
note: A compliment learners hear a lot; reply いえいえ、まだまだです.

reading: そうなんだ
note: The everyday listening response among friends.

reading: そうなんですか
note: Polite listening response showing interest.

reading: へえしらなかった
note: Reacting to new information from a friend.

reading: ほんとう
note: Quick surprised reaction; in speech often ほんと？

reading: いいなあ
note: Mild, friendly envy when a friend shares good news or a trip.

reading: たしかに
note: Agreeing with something a friend said; very common in chat too.
